rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Fighting the <color(5)>Siberian Railway<ce()> again, huh...
rows.notes: Source uses the clipped nickname (Shibe-tetsu); rendered as the locked full 'Siberian Railway' per terms_028.json (no attested English clipped form).

rows.en: <operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>. You're thinking about that girl... <color(5)>Cynthia<ce()>, aren't you?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Eh... no way.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>I can tell simply by looking at your face.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>If she shows up, this time we really have to stop her for good.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I'll teach <color(5)>Cynthia<ce()> that war and games aren't the same thing. With my own hands.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Is <color(6)>Norb<ce()> really that amazing a person?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>The first human ever chosen to mediate with the Scub was <color(6)>Norb<ce()>.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>But <color(6)>Norb<ce()> failed at that dialogue - after fusing the Compac Drive into his own body.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>But because of that, <color(6)>Norb<ce()> can use the Compac Drive to hear the Scub's voice.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>He's essential if we're ever to open dialogue with the Scub again.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Norb<ce()> will guide you, <color(4)>Renton<ce()>, <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>, you're paired with <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>. Be sure to protect <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, always.
rows.notes: Source repeats 'Eureka' 3 times (once as 'her' would read naturally in English); kept literal repetition to preserve the 3 color spans.

rows.en: <operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... got it.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Renton<ce()>... I'll try hard too. I feel like <color(4)>Renton<ce()> and I can do anything.
rows.notes: Source has Eureka refer to Renton by name twice rather than 'you'; kept literal to preserve both color spans.

rows.en: <operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>While I'm at it, let me tell an old story. ...How <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> and I first met.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Back in my United Federation of Predgio Towers days, I served in the SOF and was put in charge of <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'United Federation of Predgio Towers' per encyclopedia_021_a lock for Tou-shuu Renpou.

rows.en: <operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Eureka<ce()> was only the girl who piloted the world's oldest LFO, <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()>... That's all I knew of her.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Two years back, we were given a mission to wipe out the resistance in Domepolis.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>At the same time, we were tasked with securing the Vodarac's high priest, <color(6)>Norb<ce()> - that's how I came to meet <color(6)>Norb<ce()>.
rows.notes: Source repeats 'Norb' twice; kept literal to preserve both color spans. 'high priest' per terms_028.json.

rows.en: <operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>The one paired with <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> is the one who can open dialogue with the Scub - that's what <color(6)>Norb<ce()> taught me.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>And that those two are the ones who can open the Great Wall - the path that saves this world.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Once I knew that, I decided to leave the military and formed <color(4)>Gekkostate<ce()>.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>So that's what happened...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I'm leaving <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> to you. I'll stop him for sure... that bastard <color(5)>Dewey<ce()>.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yes!!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, did you know about the Scub Coral?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>No... When I was with the <color(5)>New Federation<ce()>, all I was ever taught was that it would destroy the world.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>If we don't learn to coexist with it, the world is doomed... that's the truth of it, huh.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>But... even if this goes right, what about the other world...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>. Let's focus on this for now. We'll find a way home after, for sure.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, you're right.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>We can't get back to our own world, and if we lose this fight too, ruin comes for this world as well...
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>It's hard to even put into words...
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Am I... never gonna get to go home like this~?
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Am I... gonna live out my life never seeing <color(4)>Linda<ce()> again?
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Try to stay positive. There's bound to be a way.
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)>That's right, staying positive's the way. Isn't that exactly like us?
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Geez... what a mess. Not being able to go home and everything.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>No use moping about it, is there.
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>Come on... would you please think this through more?
rows.notes: Source addresses Focker as 'senpai'; left unnamed rather than inventing an address term.

rows.en: <operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>I know, I know. But panicking won't get us anywhere.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Isamu<ce()>... that's not like you. No matter what, you were always the bird that flew on strong wings.
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>...Yeah, you're right.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Are we really all right doing something like this?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>If <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> says so, I believe it!
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>You're more fired up than I've ever seen you.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>But... I can't say anything for certain. I'm sorry, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>It's fine, <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s got plenty on his plate now too. Can't let myself fall behind him.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, be careful out there. Who knows what might show up.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>What's this? <color(4)>Sara<ce()> cheering me on, of all things...
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Sh-shut up! Is it a crime to worry about you!?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>S-sorry...
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Kids these days sure are complicated.

uncertainties.issue: Source colors 'Eureka' 3 times in one row ('paired with Eureka... protect Eureka'); a natural English draft would use 'her' for the second instance, but the name was repeated instead to keep 3 color spans matching the source tag count.

Source has Eureka say Renton's name twice rather than 'you' the second time; kept literal ('with Renton, I feel like...') to preserve both color spans, though 'with you' would read more naturally in English.
Source repeats 'Norb' twice in one row for the two color spans; rendered with both occurrences, slightly redundant in English.
Hikaru addresses Focker as 'senpai' (senior); no name is in the source line itself, so left as a plain address-free line rather than inserting 'Focker' or an invented honorific.
